info.name: Clerk Backend Account Portal Machines API
Get a List of Machines for an Instance

params.name: limit
params.description:
Applies a limit to the number of results returned.
Can be used for paginating the results together with `offset`.

params.name: offset
params.description:
Skip the first `offset` results when paginating.
Needs to be an integer greater or equal to zero.
To be used in conjunction with `limit`.

params.name: query
params.description: Returns machines with ID or name that match the given query. Uses exact match for machine ID and partial match for name.

params.name: order_by
params.description:
Allows to return machines in a particular order.
You can order the returned machines by their `name` or `created_at`.
To specify the direction, use the `+` or `-` symbols prepended to the property to order by.
For example, to return machines in descending order by `created_at`, use `-created_at`.
If you don't use `+` or `-`, then `+` is implied.
Defaults to `-created_at`.

items.docs:
This request returns the list of machines for an instance. The machines are
ordered by descending creation date (i.e. most recent machines will be
returned first)

params.name: machine_id
params.description: The ID of the machine to retrieve

items.docs:
Rotates the machine's secret key.
When the secret key is rotated, make sure to update it in your machine/application.
The previous secret key will remain valid for the duration specified by the previous_token_ttl parameter.
